MONITORING_METHODS.label: SNMP
MONITORING_METHODS.hint: v2c/v3 polling — switches, routers, firewalls, UPS. Needs community string or v3 user.

MONITORING_METHODS.label: Node Exporter
MONITORING_METHODS.hint: Linux agent on :9100 — CPU, memory, disk, NIC. Install via ansible role or rpm/deb.

MONITORING_METHODS.label: Windows Exporter
MONITORING_METHODS.hint: Windows agent on :9182 — CPU, memory, disk, services, IIS/SQL collectors.

MONITORING_METHODS.label: Blackbox Ping
MONITORING_METHODS.hint: ICMP/TCP/HTTP probe from the poller — availability + latency only, agentless.

MONITORING_METHODS.label: iDRAC / iLO
MONITORING_METHODS.hint: Out-of-band Redfish/IPMI — power, fans, temperature, RAID, even when OS is down.

MONITORING_METHODS.label: API Polling
MONITORING_METHODS.hint: Vendor REST API (vCenter, Purity, ONTAP, FortiOS). Needs API token.
